title: Farrer Park Hospital Crawler
description: Web crawler for extracting specialist doctor information from Farrer Park Hospital website. Crawls all pages automatically.

headless.title: 🖥️ Headless Mode
headless.description: Run browser in headless mode. Set to false for debugging, true for production.

outputFilename.title: 📁 Output Filename (Optional)
outputFilename.description: Custom filename for the output JSON file (without .json extension). If not provided, will use default naming.

proxyConfiguration.title: 🌐 Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Configure proxy settings for the crawler

maxRotationPerSession.title: 🔄 Max Rotation Per Session
maxRotationPerSession.description: Maximum number of proxy rotations allowed per session

maxRetries.title: 🔄 Max Retries for Server/Network Errors
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for server or network errors

maxRequestTimeout.title: ⏱️ Max Request Timeout (seconds)
maxRequestTimeout.description: Maximum timeout for individual requests in seconds
